 Follow Us On: News Sports Hockey India vs South Korea: India blow away Korea with 8-0 win Advertisement Asian Champions Trophy 2026 India vs South Korea, Asian Champions Trophy: India blow away Korea with 8-0 win
 India Today Sports Desk Jalandhar , UPDATED: Nov 2, 2026 21:36 IST India vs South Korea, Asian Champions Trophy: Harmanpreet Singh's India have beaten South Korea 8-0 in Jalandhar on Monday and will go into the semifinals unbeaten. India vs South Korea, Asian Champions Trophy Live Updates. Courtesy: Hockey India 
 Hello and welcome to our live coverage of the Asian Champions Trophy, where defending champions India take on South Korea.
 26 Nov 2, 2026 21:35 IST IND vs KOR: How India hammered South Korea
 Another day. Another India win and we are done in Jalandhar. 
 India put on a clinic and thrashed Korea 8-0 to make it 5 out of 5 and get ready for the semis in style. 
 India put the game almost to bed in the first 15 minutes with three goals. 
 The second quarter was a little cagey for the Indian side as Korea piled on the PCs. 
 The third quarter was when India put Korea to the sword. Four goals in the matter of 10 minutes ended the game and then they finished it off in the final quarter. 
 The action now moves to Mohali as we get ready for the semis and final. 
 India will face Korea again and Japan will face Malaysia in the second semifinal.
 Nov 2, 2026 21:13 IST IND vs KOR: India dominate league stage 
 India sign off from the opening stage in emphatic fashion, delivering exactly the kind of dominance expected of them.
 Five matches, five wins, 34 goals scored and just five conceded — the hosts have been in a league of their own. But the real test awaits in Mohali, where the semifinals and final will be played.
 India will renew their rivalry with South Korea on Wednesday evening, while Malaysia take on Japan in the other semifinal. The knockout battle is officially on!
 Nov 2, 2026 20:58 IST IND vs KOR: India take 8-0 lead in Jalandhar 
 GOAL! Angad Bir makes Korea pay for a costly defensive lapse!
 The Koreans lose possession deep inside their own half, and the youngster wastes no time in capitalising. Angad drives into the circle with purpose, takes on goalkeeper Kim and unleashes a powerful reverse-hit.
 The ball flies underneath the advancing goalkeeper and into the net. A brilliant finish from the youngster, who finally gets his name on the scoresheet!
 advertisement Nov 2, 2026 20:50 IST IND vs KOR: Quiet last quarter thus far
 The fourth quarter has been a cagey affair so far, with neither side managing to create a clear-cut scoring opportunity.
 Both teams have struggled to find their attacking rhythm, seemingly saving their best for the bigger battle ahead.
 With the semifinal clash against each other coming up on Wednesday, this final quarter has turned into a cautious dress rehearsal rather than an all-out contest.
 Nov 2, 2026 20:36 IST IND vs KOR: END OF Q3!
 That was just pure dominance!
 India smashed Korea out of the park and it is a perfect way to end the leg here in Jalandhar. Some of the fans are heading off early to avoid the Jalandhar traffic. 
 Nov 2, 2026 20:30 IST IND vs KOR: GOAL!!! India hit seven
 40' It's getting ridiculous at the moment now. 
 India have hit Korea out of the park now, making it 7-0. Harmanpreet Singh plays the ball into Sanjay who unleashes a vicious shot towards goal. That seemed destined for the net but Dilpreet put his stamp on it with a cute deflection. 
 advertisement Nov 2, 2026 20:25 IST IND vs KOR: GOAL!!!! 
 36' It's a goal rush in Jalandhar!
 Brilliant bit of work from Sanjay and that goal is all about him. He comes from the left and puts in a one-two with Shilanand first and then he gives the ball to Dilpreet. The forward's shot was blocked and Sanjay pounced to make it 6-0. 
 Nov 2, 2026 20:20 IST IND vs KOR: GOAL!!! SUKHJEET JOINS IN ON GOAL SPREE
 34' One way traffic at the moment and Korea are well and truly out from this one. 
 Harmanpreet puts in a ball into the D and it is passed on to Sukhjeet by Aditya Arjun Lallage. He has the simple job of putting it into the net and now it is 5-0. 
 Nov 2, 2026 20:19 IST IND vs KOR: GOAL! Shilanand makes it 4-0
 33' A sensational start for India and they're well on their way to making it 5 out of 5 here. A PC variation from India here and Jugraj's shot is saved. But Shilanand makes sure India get their 4th goal. 
 advertisement Nov 2, 2026 20:03 IST IND vs KOR Live: HALF TIME!
 Korea showed more intent in that quarter and managed to test Krishan Pathak with a couple of efforts. India, meanwhile, appeared to ease off the intensity after building a healthy lead. That is unlikely to sit too well with Craig Fulton. Nevertheless, the hosts head into the break firmly in control at 3-0 and remain on course to wrap up the league stage with a flawless 15 points from five matches.
 Nov 2, 2026 20:02 IST IND vs KOR Live: India's 4th goal ruled out
 27' A PC for India and Jugraj's shot is well saved by the goalkeeper. Harmanpreet gets the ball back and sends a pass into the D and it is nudged home by Vishnukant. But there was a doubt of a back stick and the replays show it was the case. 
 NO goal for now. India continue on pushing. 
 Nov 2, 2026 19:53 IST IND vs KOR live: India searching for 4th goal
 23' After a bit of a lull period, India seems to have found their groove again with a high press and some good passing. Sanjay's high press works and the ball goes to Arjun Lallage and his shot is just wide. 
 Nov 2, 2026 19:47 IST IND vs KOR live: India defending well in PC situations
 20' One of the best points for India this tournament has been the way how defend well in PCs. Twice, the Indian rushers made stops to prevent Korea from pulling one back. The final attempt was well-wide and India preserve their 3-goal lead. 
 Nov 2, 2026 19:41 IST IND vs KOR: Shilanand misses big chance
 17' India are off to a fast start here and Shilanand almost made it 4-0. India keep winning the ball high up on the field and Shilanand uses incredible stick work to make it into the Korean D. There was some one-touch stuff with Angad inside, but Kim runs in to ensure Shilanand's angle was a tight one. 
 Nov 2, 2026 19:35 IST IND vs KOR: GOAL!!!! HARMANPREET SCORES!
 GOAL! Harmanpreet is on the board!
 That is ridiculous power. Outstanding stuff from Harmanpreet, as he smashes it low and into the corner. No chance for Kim Jaehyon in the Korean goal.
 With that the first quarter is done and it has been a dominant performance from India. Can they add more to the scoreline?
 Nov 2, 2026 19:29 IST IND vs KOR: GOAL! JUGRAJ MAKES IT 2-0!
 India get two PCs in a row and the first attempt from Harmanpreet is stopped by the rusher. The second one wasn't trapped well and India recycled the ball well back to harman. The Indian captain tried to get a deflection from Dilpreet and it was saved. 
 The ball fell kindly to Vishnukant, who produced a wonderful pass to Jugraj and he made it 2-0. Korea need a strong performance in the second half to make a comeback. 
 Nov 2, 2026 19:24 IST IND vs KOR: GOAL!!! INDIA TAKE THE LEAD!
 8' Dilpreet produces a sensational strike to put India ahead as the Jalandhar crowd erupts in joy. A beautiful cross field ball to Jarmanpreet on the right creates chaos in the Korean D. The Indian defender is able to find the pass and it falls to Dilpreet and his reverse shot gives Kim no chance to save it. 
 A video referral by the umpire was taken, but ultimately it was decided in India's favour. 
 Nov 2, 2026 19:20 IST IND vs KOR: Early chance for India
 3' Sukhjeet is making it a habit of using that reverse hit to perfection. He gets the ball inside the D and stings the hand of Kim here with a fine shot. India are pushing for that early goal to settle the nerves here.
 Nov 2, 2026 19:16 IST IND vs KOR Live: PUSHBACK!
 The match is underway here and India will be kicking us off, going from right to left. Usually they do that in the second half. An early press is evident but Korea are holding themselves well here. 
 Nov 2, 2026 19:03 IST ACT Live: Punjab CM special guest
 So for the final match in Jalandhar, Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann is in the stadium and is taking a quick lap around the stadium as the teams are proceeding with the toss. korea win the toss here.
